text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Drug Enforcement Commission and the National Investigation Services of Britain have smashed a highly organised Lusaka-London hashish syndicate.
- The Copperbelt Energy Consortium, successful bidder for the Power Division of Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines, says it will lay of a substantial number of workers.
- Labour minister Peter Machungwa says the government is working on a minimum wages law to stop slavery wages obtaining in many companies.
- A Dutch rose farming consultant says Zambia's rose exports are failing to compete favourably on the world market.
